hypothesis: Exact-span evidence fails on B because structural children omit inter-block seams and treat H2-H6 headings as retrieval barriers. Lossless contiguous windows that absorb H2-H6 headings and whitespace seams, with deterministic left overlap, should recover evidence toward A without semantic chunking or Candidate C.
algorithm: Build a lossless source-segment ledger from frozen B children plus whitespace seams. Greedy left-to-right cores from consecutive packable segments (paragraph, complete list unit, H2-H6 heading, whitespace seam) until the complete serialization would exceed 254 content tokens or a hard barrier. After each core, prepend the maximal immediately preceding compatible suffix that still fits. One retrieval unit per core. No backtracking or post-result overlap tuning.

order: entry breadcrumb of the first non-seam segment, excluding headings whose full source text is already in the slice
verbatim contiguous source slice from retrieval_start to retrieval_end
serialization.separators: title + LF + join(breadcrumb, ' > ') + LF + LF + slice

classification: Reuse frozen 5A2 hybrid QUALITY_KEYS against A as the primary reference and against B and B-PACKED diagnostically
